title: Payment methods and credit-card problems
required_reference_topics: Approved payment troubleshooting/change and purchase authorisation procedures.
Independent failure reasons, accepted methods, material amounts and transaction outcomes.

check_conditions.procedure.information: Distinguish a rejected payment, payment-method change and separately requested assisted purchase. Establish required order/payment state and any approved troubleshooting/verification prerequisites.
check_conditions.procedure.actions: Distinguish a rejected payment, payment-method change and separately requested assisted purchase. Use the eligible troubleshooting or authorised payment/change/purchase action with correct target and supported values. Compare the recorded agreed operation here; required verification/eligibility/permission relationships remain in procedure.order_permission, and factual policy claims require independent eligible support in Answer support.
check_conditions.procedure.order_permission: Establish required order/payment state and any approved troubleshooting/verification prerequisites. Apply explicit status/order requirements and permission before making a charge or purchase.
check_conditions.completeness: Recognise the actual payment issue and any subsequent method change or purchase request. Address each failed attempt, requested change and authorised assisted purchase separately.
check_conditions.completeness.promises_next_steps: Account for actual payment/change/purchase results; a retry suggestion is not proof of payment success. Explain actual pending transactions, supported alternatives and required customer steps.
check_conditions.communication-style: Clearly distinguish troubleshooting, changing a method and charging the customer; do not request unnecessary sensitive data.
check_conditions.answer-support: Eligible payment instructions and authoritative decline, order, payment-method and transaction records.
